newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE TURNOVER HALVES IN LIGHT TRADING.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE TURNOVER HALVES IN LIGHT TRADING.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest
stock exchange on Thursday plunged to less than half the
previous level of 53.3 million lei.
"We anticipated demand would be light today but a turnover
of 25.9 million lei is below our grimmest expectations," said
one trader.
Volume also halved from the previous level to 4,288 shares.
Four stocks climbed, three drifted lower, two were unchanged
and four had no trade.
Syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended from
trading pending an annoucement on decisions by a recent meeting
of shareholders.
"Buyers again focused on Azomures and Artrom and newcomer
Electroceramica aroused little interest," another trader said.
Fertiliser maker Azomures SA took 65 percent of
turnover and closed a slight 100 lei lower at 11,000.
Artrom SA engineering company traded half the
total shares which changed hands on Thursday and closed 100 lei
higher at 2,100.
Brokers said they had been simply probing into
Electroceramica SA electric equipment maker, which joined the
other 14 listed companies.
"But its shares made a nice price today, very close to
their nominal value," said a broker.
Electroceramica closed at 20,000 lei. The company's shares
have a face value of 25,000 lei each.
The VAB unofficial value-weighted index, computed by
Vanguard SA securities, dropped by 0.06 percent from the
previous session to 299.03 points. The other independent index,
Bucharest Investment Group's BIG rose by 0.01 percent 298.37
points.
